dogecoin.text:
weird corollary: I could just invest another $35 in dogecoin now, to regret-minimize in case it triples again

but I don't think that's a good idea!

therefore I should completely stop thinking about this!

it is difficult having a brain full of normal human biases

turns out my dogecoin that I bought for $10 in 2014 would be worth $35 today if I could find it

weirdly I am much more attached to those $35 than to any other $35

kinda glad I'm not a lost-bitcoin would-be millionaire, I'd feel like hell

my lost dogecoin would now be more like $22, not $35

... no, I'm totally over it, why do you ask
